F.  ORAL STAFF REPORT(S)

Joe Jimenez, Recreation and Community Services Director, announced that the first open Street Fair
will be held on Saturday, September 23, 2023 from 8:00 am – 2:00 pm; and that staff is working on
programing starting in October to impliment a 12­week program for youth involving sports for 3­6 year
olds.

G.  CITY ATTORNEY REPORT(S)

There were no City Attorney Reports.

H.  ORAL COUNCIL REPORT(S)

Councilmember Roa reported that he attended the Teen Center Open House; and attended the Contract
Cities conference.

Councilmember De Paula thanked the local barbers who donated free haircuts; reported that he
attended the Contract Cities conference; attended Boba Tea with a Deputy; and attended the Teen
Center Open House.

Councilmember Vargas thanked the Teen Center staff.

Mayor Pro Tem Farfan reported that he attended the Teen Center Open House; and Boba Tea with a
Deputy.

Mayor Del Rio reported that she attended the Gateway City Conference; attended Contract Cities
conference; and congratulated Melissa Flores from our Sister City, who will represent Mexico in Miss
Universe.

I.  CLOSED SESSION

There were no Closed Session items.

J.  ADJOURNMENT

The City Council adjourned the meeting at 6:39 PM to the next City Council meeting to be held on
Tuesday, September 26, 2023, at 6:00 PM
